headline: Napoli vs Roma: a near coin-flip on the market
summary: The market makes Roma a narrow favourite at a fair 37.8%, with Napoli at 34.4% and the draw at 27.7% — close to a coin flip. The biggest moves since we started tracking are small: Napoli's level-ball handicap firmed from 44.7% to 47.3% on consensus, while Roma eased from 38.9% to 37.8% on the sharp market. Two details keep this measured. The handicap's fair line moved only 0.04, and only 5 books quote it. We also hold just 5 price snapshots over 45.9 hours, and every first mover is stamped at the same moment — consistent with a collection snapshot rather than informed money. Goals give no direction either: over 2.5 sits at 50.9%. Both listed injuries were on our first injury list, so we cannot date when they became public.
